verdict.rationale: Supabase documents an AI Assistant built into the Dashboard. It generates schema SQL from specifications, diagnoses SQL errors and suggests fixes, and gives table-specific recommendations. It also offers a real delegation path: users can generate and deploy Edge Functions automatically via the AI Assistant. Most other documented abilities are generation or advice rather than autonomous execution. missing for 10: evidence the assistant can carry out multi-step tasks or apply changes beyond function deploys, documented approval/permission controls for its actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
